career_history.title: Senior AI Engineer

The most interesting technical challenge was the cold-start problem for new users; I designed an exploration-exploitation policy using Thompson sampling that improved new-user retention by 11% in the first month.

career_history.title: Lead AI Engineer

Cost per inference dropped from $0.04 with GPT-3.5-fallback to under $0.001.
